title: एकविंशतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: The Kauravas, with Karna in front, return to battle, and Arjuna twangs Gandiva and fights as if dancing, drawing them into a trap of arrows. The beasts of prey and spirits gather over the field of the slain.
summary.kn: ಕರ್ಣನನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟು ಕೌರವರು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಗಾಂಡೀವ ಟಂಕಾರ ಮಾಡಿ ನರ್ತಿಸುವಂತೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಬಾಣದ ಬಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಹತರ ರಣರಂಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೃಗ, ಭೂತಗಳು ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: कर्ण को आगे रखकर कौरव फिर युद्ध में आते हैं, और अर्जुन गाण्डीव की टंकार के साथ नाचते हुए लड़कर उन्हें बाणों के जाल में फँसा लेते हैं। मरे हुओं की रणभूमि पर हिंसक पशु और भूत जुटते हैं।
summary.te: కర్ణుని ముందుంచి కౌరవులు మళ్లీ పోరుకు వస్తారు; అర్జునుడు గాండీవం మోగిస్తూ నృత్యం చేస్తున్నట్లు పోరాడి వారిని బాణాల వలలో చిక్కించుకుంటాడు. హతుల రణభూమిపై క్రూరమృగాలు, భూతాలు చేరతాయి.
summary.ta: கர்ணனை முன்வைத்துக் கௌரவர் மீண்டும் போருக்கு வர, அர்ஜுனன் காண்டீவம் முழங்கி நடனமாடுவது போல் போரிட்டு அவர்களை அம்புவலையில் சிக்கவைக்கிறான். மாண்டவரின் களத்தின் மீது விலங்குகளும் பேய்களும் கூடுகின்றன.
summary.ml: കർണ്ണനെ മുന്നിൽ നിർത്തി കൗരവർ വീണ്ടും യുദ്ധത്തിനെത്തുന്നു; അർജുനൻ ഗാണ്ഡീവം വലിച്ച് നൃത്തം ചെയ്യുന്നതുപോലെ പൊരുതി, അവരെ അമ്പുകളുടെ കെണിയിൽ വീഴ്ത്തുന്നു. കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഇരപിടിയന്മാരായ മൃഗങ്ങളും ഭൂതങ്ങളും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.21; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः कर्णं पुरस्कृत्य त्वदीया युद्धदुर्मदाः ।
पुनरावृत्य संग्रामं चक्रुर्देवासुरोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, putting Karna at their head, your men, wild for battle, turned back and fought again a battle like that of the gods and demons.

verses.text:
द्विरदरथनराश्वशङ्खशब्दैः
परिहृषिता विविधैश्च शस्त्रपातैः ।
द्विरदरथपदातिसार्थवाहाः
परिपतिताभिमुखाः प्रजह्रिरे ते ॥

meaning.en: Gladdened by the sounds of elephants, chariots, men, horses and conches, and by showers of many weapons, the throngs of elephants, chariots and foot-soldiers, running at each other, struck one another.

verses.text:
शरपरशुवरासिपट्टिशै-
रिषुभिरनेकविधैश्च सादिताः ।
द्विरदरथहया महाहवे
वरपुरुषैः पुरुषाश्च वाहनैः ॥

meaning.en: With arrows, axes, fine swords, pattishas and many kinds of arrows, elephants, chariots and horses in the great battle were struck down by the best of men, and men by their mounts.

verses.text:
कमलदिनकरेन्दुसंनिभैः
सितदशनैः सुमुखाक्षिनासिकैः ।
रुचिरमुकुटकुण्डलैर्मही
पुरुषशिरोभिरवस्तृता बभौ ॥

meaning.en: The earth was spread with men's heads, which were like lotuses, the sun and the moon, with white teeth, fair faces, eyes and noses, and lovely crowns and earrings, and it shone.

verses.text:
परिघमुसलशक्तितोमरै-
र्नखरभुशुण्डिगदाशतैर्द्रुताः ।
द्विरदनरहयाः सहस्रशो
रुधिरनदीप्रवहास्तदाभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Hurried along by clubs, maces, spears, tomaras, claw-weapons, bhushundis and hundreds of maces, thousands of elephants, men and horses became rivers of blood.

verses.text:
प्रहतनररथाश्वकुञ्जरं
प्रतिभयदर्शनमुल्बणं तदा ।
तदहितनिहतं बभौ बलं
पितृपतिराष्ट्रमिव प्रजाक्षये ॥

meaning.en: That terrifying and savage army, with men, chariots, horses and elephants struck down, killed by its enemies, looked like the kingdom of Yama's realm at the destruction of creatures.

verses.text:
अथ तव नरदेव सैनिका-
स्तव च सुताः सुरसूनुसंनिभाः ।
अमितबलपुरःसरा रणे
कुरुवृषभाः शिनिपुत्रमभ्ययुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, your soldiers and your sons, like sons of the gods, and the bulls of the Kurus, led by the immensely powerful ones, went against Shini's son in the battle.

verses.text:
तदतिरुचिरभीममाबभौ
पुरुषवराश्वरथद्विपाकुलम् ।
लवणजलसमुद्धतस्वनं
बलममरासुरसैन्यसंनिभम् ॥

meaning.en: That army, very beautiful and fearful, crowded with the best of men, horses, chariots and elephants, with a roar like the salt sea rising, shone like an army of gods and demons.

verses.text:
सुरपतिसमविक्रमस्तत-
स्त्रिदशवरावरजोपमं युधि ।
दिनकरकिरणप्रभैः पृषत्कै
रवितनयोऽभ्यहनच्छिनिप्रवीरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, Surya's son, equal in valor to Indra, struck the Shini hero in battle, who was like the younger brother of the best of the gods, with arrows shining like the sun's rays.

verses.text:
तमपि सरथवाजिसारथिं
शिनिवृषभो विविधैः शरैस्त्वरन् ।
भुजगविषसमप्रभै रणे
पुरुषवरं समवास्तृणोत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then the Shini bull in turn quickly covered that best of men, with his chariot, horses and charioteer, in the battle with various arrows bright as snake poison.

verses.text:
शिनिवृषभशरप्रपीडितं
तव सुहृदो वसुषेणमभ्ययुः ।
त्वरितमतिरथा रथर्षभं
द्विरदरथाश्वपदातिभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: Pressed by the arrows of the Shini bull, your friends, great chariot-warriors, quickly came with elephants, chariots, horses and foot-soldiers toward Vasusena, that bull of chariot-warriors.

verses.text:
तमुदधिनिभमाद्रवद्बली
त्वरिततरैः समभिद्रुतं परैः ।
द्रुपदसुतसखस्तदाकरो-
त्पुरुषरथाश्वगजक्षयं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Ocean-like, surrounded by swifter enemies, the strong friend of Drupada's son then made a great destruction of men, chariots, horses and elephants.

verses.text:
अथ पुरुषवरौ कृताह्निकौ
भवमभिपूज्य यथाविधि प्रभुम् ।
अरिवधकृतनिश्चयौ द्रुतं
तव बलमर्जुनकेशवौ सृतौ ॥

meaning.en: Then the two best of men, Arjuna and Keshava, having done their daily rites and worshiped the lord Bhava according to rule, resolved to kill the enemy and quickly came upon your force.

verses.text:
जलदनिनदनिस्वनं रथं
पवनविधूतपताककेतनम् ।
सितहयमुपयान्तमन्तिकं
हृतमनसो ददृशुस्तदारयः ॥

meaning.en: The enemies, their minds stolen, then saw the chariot with its white horses coming near, its sound like thunder-clouds and its banner shaken by the wind.

verses.text:
अथ विस्फार्य गाण्डीवं रणे नृत्यन्निवार्जुनः ।
शरसंबाधमकरोत्खं दिशः प्रदिशस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna, stretching Gandiva and dancing as it were in the battle, filled the sky, directions and intermediate directions with a crowd of arrows.

verses.text:
रथान्विमानप्रतिमान्सज्जयन्त्रायुधध्वजान् ।
ससारथींस्तदा बाणैरभ्राणीवानिलोऽवधीत् ॥

meaning.en: With arrows he struck down chariots like celestial cars, with their machines, weapons and banners, with their charioteers, as the wind scatters clouds.

verses.text:
गजान्गजप्रयन्तॄंश्च वैजयन्त्यायुधध्वजान् ।
सादिनोऽश्वांश्च पत्तींश्च शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: He sent elephants, their drivers, their victory standards and weapons, horsemen, horses and foot-soldiers with arrows to Yama's abode.

verses.text:
तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धमनिवार्यं महारथम् ।
दुर्योधनोऽभ्ययादेको निघ्नन्बाणैः पृथग्विधैः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana alone went against that great chariot-warrior, who was angry like Death and could not be held back, striking at him with many kinds of arrows.

verses.text:
तस्यार्जुनो धनुः सूतं केतुमश्वांश्च सायकैः ।
हत्वा सप्तभिरेकैकं छत्रं चिच्छेद पत्रिणा ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna killed his bow, charioteer, banner and horses with arrows, seven of them, one for each, and cut his parasol with another arrow.

verses.text:
नवमं च समासाद्य व्यसृजत्प्रतिघातिनम् ।
दुर्योधनायेषुवरं तं द्रौणिः सप्तधाच्छिनत् ॥

meaning.en: Then taking a ninth, he loosed the best of arrows, the counter-striker, at Duryodhana, but Drona's son cut it into seven pieces.

verses.text:
ततो द्रौणेर्धनुश्छित्त्वा हत्वा चाश्ववराञ्शरैः ।
कृपस्यापि तथात्युग्रं धनुश्चिच्छेद पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna cut Drona's son's bow and killed his best horses with arrows, and also cut Kripa's very fierce bow.

verses.text:
हार्दिक्यस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा ध्वजं चाश्वं तथावधीत् ।
दुःशासनस्येषुवरं छित्त्वा राधेयमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Having cut Hardikya's bow, he killed his standard and horses, and cutting Duhshasana's best arrow he went toward Radha's son.

verses.text:
अथ सात्यकिमुत्सृज्य त्वरन्कर्णोऽर्जुनं त्रिभिः ।
विद्ध्वा विव्याध विंशत्या कृष्णं पार्थं पुनस्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, quickly leaving Satyaki, pierced Arjuna with three arrows and twenty, and again pierced Krishna and Partha with three.

verses.text:
अथ सात्यकिरागत्य कर्णं विद्ध्वा शितैः शरैः ।
नवत्या नवभिश्चोग्रैः शतेन पुनरार्दयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki came up and pierced Karna with sharp arrows, tormenting him with ninety, nine fierce ones, and again with a hundred.

verses.text:
ततः प्रवीराः पाण्डूनां सर्वे कर्णमपीडयन् ।
युधामन्युः शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः ॥

meaning.en: Then all the Pandava heroes pressed Karna: Yudhamanyu, Shikhandi, the sons of Draupadi, the Prabhadrakas,

verses.text:
उत्तमौजा युयुत्सुश्च यमौ पार्षत एव च ।
चेदिकारूषमत्स्यानां केकयानां च यद्बलम् ।
चेकितानश्च बलवान्धर्मराजश्च सुव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Uttamaujas, Yuyutsu, the twins and the Prishata prince, and the forces of the Chedis, Karushas, Matsyas and Kekayas, the mighty Chekitana and the king of dharma of firm vows.

verses.text:
एते रथाश्वद्विरदैः पत्तिभिश्चोग्रविक्रमैः ।
परिवार्य रणे कर्णं नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरन् ।
भाषन्तो वाग्भिरुग्राभिः सर्वे कर्णवधे वृताः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounding Karna in the battle with chariots, horses, elephants and fierce-valiant foot-soldiers, they covered him with many weapons, all of them speaking harsh words and resolved on Karna's death.

verses.text:
तां शस्त्रवृष्टिं बहुधा छित्त्वा कर्णः शितैः शरैः ।
अपोवाह स्म तान्सर्वान्द्रुमान्भङ्क्त्वेव मारुतः ॥

meaning.en: Cutting that rain of weapons in many ways with sharp arrows, Karna swept them all away, as the wind breaks trees.

verses.text:
रथिनः समहामात्रान्गजानश्वान्ससादिनः ।
शरव्रातांश्च संक्रुद्धो निघ्नन्कर्णो व्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Angry, Karna was seen striking down chariot-warriors with their elephant-drivers, elephants, horses with riders, and masses of arrows.

verses.text:
तद्वध्यमानं पाण्डूनां बलं कर्णास्त्रतेजसा ।
विशस्त्रक्षतदेहं च प्राय आसीत्पराङ्मुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the might of Karna's weapon, the Pandavas' force, with bodies cut and left without weapons, almost wholly turned away.

verses.text:
अथ कर्णास्त्रमस्त्रेण प्रतिहत्यार्जुनः स्वयम् ।
दिशः खं चैव भूमिं च प्रावृणोच्छरवृष्टिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna himself, countering Karna's weapon with his own, covered the directions, the sky and the earth with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
मुसलानीव निष्पेतुः परिघा इव चेषवः ।
शतघ्न्य इव चाप्यन्ये वज्राण्युग्राणि वापरे ॥

meaning.en: They fell like pestles, like clubs, and others like hundred-slayers or fierce thunderbolts.

verses.text:
तैर्वध्यमानं तत्सैन्यं सपत्त्यश्वरथद्विपम् ।
निमीलिताक्षमत्यर्थमुदभ्राम्यत्समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by them, that army with its foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants, closed its eyes tight and wandered about on every side.

verses.text:
निष्कैवल्यं तदा युद्धं प्रापुरश्वनरद्विपाः ।
वध्यमानाः शरैरन्ये तदा भीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Horses, men and elephants then fell into utter ruin in the battle, and others, struck by arrows, fled in fear.

verses.text:
एवं तेषां तदा युद्धे संसक्तानां जयैषिणाम् ।
गिरिमस्तं समासाद्य प्रत्यपद्यत भानुमान् ॥

meaning.en: Thus while they were locked in that fight, each longing for victory, the sun reached the western mountain and set.

verses.text:
तमसा च महाराज रजसा च विशेषतः ।
न किंचित्प्रत्यपश्याम शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् ॥

meaning.en: O great king, because of the darkness and especially the dust, we could see nothing, good or bad.

verses.text:
ते त्रसन्तो महेष्वासा रात्रियुद्धस्य भारत ।
अपयानं ततश्चक्रुः सहिताः सर्ववाजिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Fearing a night battle, O Bharata, those great archers withdrew all together with all their horses.

verses.text:
कौरवेषु च यातेषु तदा राजन्दिनक्षये ।
जयं सुमनसः प्राप्य पार्थाः स्वशिबिरं ययुः ॥

meaning.en: When the Kauravas had gone, at the end of the day, O king, the sons of Pritha, glad at heart with victory, went to their camp.

verses.text:
वादित्रशब्दैर्विविधैः सिंहनादैश्च नर्तितैः ।
परानवहसन्तश्च स्तुवन्तश्चाच्युतार्जुनौ ॥

meaning.en: With many kinds of instruments, lion-roars and dances, laughing at their enemies and praising Achyuta and Arjuna, they went.

verses.text:
कृतेऽवहारे तैर्वीरैः सैनिकाः सर्व एव ते ।
आशिषः पाण्डवेयेषु प्रायुज्यन्त नरेश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: When the retreat had been made by those heroes, all the soldiers, O lords of men, spoke blessings over the sons of Pandu.

verses.text:
ततः कृतेऽवहारे च प्रहृष्टाः कुरुपाण्डवाः ।
निशायां शिबिरं गत्वा न्यविशन्त नरेश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: Then, when the retreat had been made, the Kurus and Pandavas, delighted, went to their camps in the night and settled there, the kings.

verses.text:
यक्षरक्षःपिशाचाश्च श्वापदानि च संघशः ।
जग्मुरायोधनं घोरं रुद्रस्यानर्तनोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: Yakshas, rakshasas, pishachas and wild beasts in packs went to that dreadful battlefield, like Rudra's dancing ground.
